scenario.title: Sam and Priya: active couple, big suburban house and backyard
scenario.room: Spacious living room with lots of clear floor, a dog-bed-sized corner, wide glass doors to a fenced grassy backyard

suggestions.name: Border Collie
suggestions.reason: Your active lifestyle and large private backyard suit this energetic, highly trainable dog perfectly.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan for daily mental games alongside physical exercise to prevent boredom.

suggestions.name: Labrador Retriever
suggestions.reason: This friendly, adaptable dog easily matches your active routine and spacious home environment.
suggestions.watch_out: Prepare for regular brushing to manage hair around the house.

suggestions.name: Australian Shepherd
suggestions.reason: Perfect for an active household with plenty of daily exercise and outdoor space available.
suggestions.watch_out: Keep their mind engaged daily with training exercises or puzzle toys.

suggestions.name: Australian Cattle Dog
suggestions.reason: Great match for your active schedule and spacious yard that needs plenty of exercise.
suggestions.watch_out: Channel their herding instincts into structured activities and daily exercise routines.

suggestions.name: Barbet
suggestions.reason: A versatile, friendly active companion that thoroughly enjoys spending quality time outdoors with you.
suggestions.watch_out: Schedule regular coat grooming to keep their curly coat free of tangles.

suggestions.name: Australian Terrier
suggestions.reason: A spirited small dog that thrives on outdoor adventures and your active daily routine.
suggestions.watch_out: Ensure your yard fencing is secure against digging tendencies.

suggestions.name: Afghan Hound
suggestions.reason: Fits well with your active schedule and yard, though they have an independent nature.
suggestions.watch_out: Expect to invest consistent time into coat care and gentle training.

suggestions.name: French Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Easygoing and low-maintenance, fitting your short home hours well despite low exercise needs.
suggestions.watch_out: Be careful not to overexert them during warm weather outdoor activities.
